service.name: Jeuno: The First Walk
service.longDescription: The first walk through the ruined streets of Jeuno — a 24-player trip back to Vana'diel with 720+ ilvl gear, the Nano Lord minion and every drop along the way. Cleared piloted by our veteran raiders.

rewards.title: High ilvl Gear - 720 ilvl
rewards.text: Chance of High item level gear from every clear, straight to your armoury.

rewards.title: Chance of items below:
rewards.text: Minions, orchestrion rolls, triple triad cards have a chance of being obtained.

rewards.title: Ordelle Coin
rewards.text: Currency that can be exchanged for tomestone gear upgrades

rewards.title: Achievement Unlocked: "Home Away from Home"
